facts.fact: The Bank of Zambia's Prohibition against Unwarranted Charges and Fees on Electronic Money Services Directives, 2024, in force on Gazette publication on 2 August 2024, ban listed e-money wallet fees and cap others, with an offence and fine for breach.
facts.system: Prohibition against Unwarranted Charges and Fees on Electronic Money Services Directives, 2024
